plan.title: Extend live RFQ by one day

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with no bids; prepared-state rules require this as the first navigation step.
Enable the eRFX project capability required by the setup.
Extend the live RFQ submission window by one day and verify the new end equals the previous end plus 24 hours.
Verify the expected confirmation message after saving the extension.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal to check that bidding remains available after the extension.
Open the prepared RFQ's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify the vendor can still submit a quote during the extended bidding window.
